messages.author: 637fa1611eba1e91
messages.subject: Remove cromosome in scan1
parts:
Hi Karl and community,

I was wondering if it is possible to run a scan1() removing one whole chromosome in the analysis.

I could not find anything in the group info or outside. Does Rqtl2 have functions to do that?

Thanks for your help and have a great day.

Juan C.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Remove cromosome in scan1
parts:
You can subset the genotype probabilities, as well as the kinship matrices if you’re using them and using “loco”:

   out <- scan1(probs[, -4], pheno, k_loco[-4])

karl
